canonical_title: Two-tier CI: always-run deterministic Fast Gate plus selective environment-dependent Full Assurance
summary: SB-OPS-CI-ARCHITECTURE-1.0 separated CI into an always-running, environment-independent Fast Gate (lint, typecheck, build, Fast Tests) executed on every PR/push, and a selective Full Assurance suite (Supabase-dependent tests) triggered only for relevant code/config/test paths plus manual dispatch, so documentation/communication-only changes do not require the slower Supabase-dependent suite.

claims.text: Fast Gate (lint, typecheck, build, and 8 environment-independent Fast Test files / 61 tests) runs on every PR/push with no Supabase test-environment dependency.

evidence.locator: ## 2. Accepted implementation, first accepted-architecture bullet: 'Fast Gate on every PR/push to main: lint, typecheck, build, 8 environment-independent Fast Tests with no Supabase test-environment binding'
## Mission outcome, first two bullets: 'every PR/push receives the always-running Fast Gate; Fast Tests are separated from the Supabase-dependent integration suite'

claims.text: Full Assurance (20 Supabase-dependent test files / 108 tests) is not run on every change; it triggers only for relevant code/config/test paths plus manual dispatch, so documentation/communication-only changes do not require the Supabase-dependent suite.

evidence.locator: ## Mission outcome, third/fourth bullets: 'Full Assurance remains available on relevant code/config/test paths and manual dispatch; documentation/communication-only changes no longer need the approximately 3.5-minute Supabase suite'

## 2. Accepted implementation, second accepted-architecture bullet: 'selective Full Assurance for relevant repository changes: 20 Supabase-dependent tests against smart-business-test, with manual dispatch retained'

conditions: Applies where there is a genuine split between environment-independent unit/lint/build checks and environment-dependent integration suites.
The path filter determining when the selective suite triggers must be kept in sync with actual test/config dependencies, or relevant changes could silently skip a needed run.
anti_patterns: Running the full environment-dependent suite unconditionally on every change regardless of relevance, incurring unnecessary latency and cost.
